note: Slot fonts per factor (J67; J37 adds an 'engine_text' key beside 'layouts' and does not change these rows). 'layouts': the .cuf slot files the scaled layouts and templates name (scale.py font_slot picks the slot as at 2x at every factor) and the size each is rendered at: render_scale x the slot file's own vanilla size (em = vanilla h2 x 23/24 x render_scale, h2 = px(vanilla h2 x render_scale)), so text named 'Ingame 12' renders at 12 x factor. At 2.0 the scale is 1 and the pack is byte-identical to J66's (5f510b27afa3). bold: drawn at wght 700 fitted to the vanilla width (cuf_encode.recipe); spaced_h2: the long-form line pitch slot (frontend_24, h2 28 at 2x). Read by uiscale/napoleon/cli.py build_fonts; the check verb reports a layout font with no row.
